analyst: This strategy trades an EMA crossover setup. A long opens when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA. A short opens when the fast EMA crosses below the slow EMA. The stop is a fixed dollar stop from the Stop ($) input, converted to points using the point value. The take-profit is likewise a fixed dollar target from the Take Profit ($) input.
